workaroundNote: Both restore every span, and both raised SDK-reported cost on these runs: the median per run went from $0.0047 to $0.0409 with the SDK pinned to 0.3.303, and to $0.0537 with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false. That's about 9x and 11x on small Haiku tasks, likely because tool definitions go back to being sent up front, though I didn't test that. A docs note saying to pin 0.3.303 would help new TypeScript users for now, but neither option is a real fix, and I measured no Python workaround.
